entry.title: PITCALL is currently onboarding
entry.body: Real Pit Calls will open when the professional pool is ready. Want to see how it works?

intro.title: Build your first demo Pit Call
intro.body: Follow the steps. We guide every choice.
intro.point_nobody: No real professional will be contacted.

dates.title: Your real travel dates
dates.hint: Your engineer needs to travel with the team. Select these required travel dates: {{range}}.
dates.note: PITCALL can tell apart professionals available for all of these dates and those available for only some of them.

req2.hint: Let's make your search more specific. Add one more skill: {{skill}}.

preview1.hint: A good starting pool. Now let's narrow it down by adding {{skill}}.

preview2.title: See what happened?
preview2.body: Adding another requirement narrowed the potential pool. This is why PITCALL lets you preview the market before posting.

post.lead: Looks good. Let's post your demo Pit Call.

callout1.title: Full match — 100%
callout1.body: Alex is available for every day you requested, and meets every professional requirement.

callout2.title: Partial match — 94%
callout2.body: James is a very strong professional match. He is Partial only because he is unavailable on one of your required days: {{day}}.

callout3.title: James partial 94% vs Marco full 88%
callout3.body: James has a higher professional relevance than Marco, even though he is a Partial match. Full / Partial tells you date availability. Relevance % tells you professional fit. A Partial match can be professionally stronger than a Full match.

end.title: That's PITCALL
end.point_dates: You defined the real travel dates.
end.point_preview: You previewed the market before posting.
end.point_requirements: You saw how requirements change the potential pool.
end.point_matches: PITCALL found Full and Partial matches and ranked their professional relevance.
end.preopen: When PITCALL opens you'll do exactly this with real professionals. Your team is already onboard — we'll let you know when real Pit Calls open.
